title: Garmin SQLite browser
description: Read-only access to the local Garmin database. Browse tables, filter records, run SQL, and export results. Refresh the page to see newly saved data.

garmin.description: Live stored values. Feature values may be stale: check feature_results.status and source timestamps before using them.

activities.description: Saved Garmin activities, keyed by account and activity ID.

days.description: Saved daily records, keyed by account and local date.

feature_results.description: Feature provenance and validity. Only status=ok results are usable.
